title: Noisy SIGNSGD Is More Differentially Private Than You (Might) Think
reviewed_version: PMLR 267 published version fetched from supplied mlresearch source URL
summary: One Major finding: arbitrary-vector GDP limit and uniform amplification are disproved by sparse antipodal inputs. One Minor finding: convergence statements omit expectations and overstate stationarity/growth qualifications; expected bounds can be repaired.
limitations: No public author source identified by the supplied bounded search; absence is not established.
Separate OpenReview attachments unavailable in frozen source preparation; embedded Appendices A-C read completely.
No author code imported or executed; no training, historical accountant or raw experiment reproduced.
Finite numerical grids support analytic counterexamples and repairs but do not prove unbounded quantifiers.
All source figures and tables actually viewed; plots not digitized and no raw-data reproduction.
The full-input-ball counterexample does not by itself establish a record-level privacy violation in any specific reported training run.

problems.location: Theorem2/Eq18-27 pp6-7; AppendixA.2 pp13-15; Remark2 p7; AppendixC.2.2 p21 and Table3 p22
problems.claim: The asserted Gaussian limit for any bounded input vectors and strictly smaller uniform GDP parameter do not hold over the full L2 ball.
problems.evidence: For x=Ce1 and xprime=-Ce1 in every dimension, extra bits are common independent fair coins. At alpha=q=Phi(-C/sigma), exact beta=q. C=sigma=1 gives .158655254 versus claimed G_mu .275664737. Gaussian postprocessing and this vertex show the best uniform full-ball GDP parameter remains exactly2C/sigma.
problems.alternative_explanation: A dispersed dense antipodal sequence has the stated Gaussian limit; restricting hypotheses with an explicit CLT condition and finite error can retain that result. A record-level accountant may use different sensitivity; actual experimental budgets are not proven violated.
problems.dependency: General vector amplification, pi/2 training-step gain and equal-privacy interpretation of related comparisons.
problems.repair: Restrict and justify the asymptotic theorem or provide valid worst-case accounting; specify adjacency, clipping, sampling, noise scales and finite composition; recalibrate comparisons.

independent_verification.source_claim: Read Definition2-3 physicalp3, Theorem2/Eq18-19p6 (actually inspected pixels), Remark2p7, proof13-15 and composition applicationp21. The theorem quantifies any vectors in the full radiusC Euclidean ball with d tending toinfinity; no dispersion restriction is given.
independent_verification.assumptions_verified: For eachd, x=Ce1 and xprime=-Ce1 both have normC; independent isotropic noise gives identical independent fair coin outputs in other coordinates. Randomized NP tests are allowed by Definition2. Fixed C=sigma=1 is covered by theorem.

decisive_check.exact_curve: f(alpha)=1-(1-q)/q*alpha for alpha<=q; q/(1-q)*(1-alpha) otherwise; q=Phi(-C/sigma)
decisive_check.uniform_mu_proof: At alpha=q, G_mu(q)=Phi(C/sigma-mu)<=q requires mu>=2C/sigma. For every full-ball pair, raw isotropic Gaussian likelihood depends on its projection along the mean difference and has GDP parameter||x-xprime||/sigma<=2C/sigma; sign postprocessing preserves that guarantee. Thus the bound is exact.

independent_verification.counterevidence: The restricted dense antipodes distribute each contribution and converge to the stated smaller Gaussian curve; numerical checks support but do not prove that CLT. A sparse pair can still improve over Gaussian tradeoff away from the tangent test level, so no denial of all information-loss/privacy amplification results. Ifsigma grows too, both curves trivially approach perfectprivacy, but the exact GDP parameter ratio for sparse inputs does not improve.
independent_verification.core_dependency: The general vector amplification and pi/2 extra-step composition premise, including claimed equal-privacy comparisons. Replacing arbitrary input by dense maximal pointwise privacy loss does not order the entire tradeoff or prove a triangular-array CLT.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Major retained: an exact counterexample to the full-ball theorem. Restrict hypotheses with finite error or provide valid worst-case accounting. Record-level adjacency/sampling may give different sensitivity, so no specific released model budget violation is asserted without actual configurations.

problems.claim: Expected descent is reported as an unqualified pathwise gradient bound; local-optimum and worker-growth wording is stronger than justified.
problems.evidence: F(w)=sqrt(1+w^2), w0=1, exact bounded gradient and positive-probability all-negative-sign trajectory yield squared gradients>=1/2 even as the printed order tends to0. Explicit expected SchemeI/II bounds are derived; M=O(T) permits M=1.
problems.alternative_explanation: Omitted expectation operators may be typographical shorthand; corrected expected stationarity results survive. The paper explicitly excludes clipping effects.
problems.dependency: Interpretation of convergence probability, stationarity, dimension dependence and privacy-utility scaling.
problems.repair: Restore expectations or prove a confidence bound, distinguish stationary from locally optimal, state lower worker growth, keep variance/std notation consistent and expose constants/dimension.

independent_verification.counterevidence: Proofs explicitly use expectation and likely intended mean-stationarity, not pathwise control. The independently derived finite bounds recover the leading stated expected rates with explicit dimension terms under the same conventional conditional-oracle reading. Rare adverse paths do not contradict these repaired results. Gradientsmall does not imply proximity to local minima; a saddle can be stationary. M=O(T) alone permitsM=1.
independent_verification.core_dependency: Probability interpretation and stationarity wording are wrong, but the mean convergence substance survives a complete supplied proof; this is why Minor is retained rather than automatic downgrading because a symbol is easy toinsert. Core general privacy guarantee is separately MajorP1.
independent_verification.severity_and_repair: Minor retained for convergence qualification after independently proving the surviving expectation results. Restore E operators or supply genuine concentration/confidence, replace localoptimum by expectedstationarity, use lower worker growth such asTheta(T), and reconcile variance/stdnotation. Keep paper exclusion of clipping effects.
independent_verification.disposition: retained with both-scheme path example clarified
